{{Quote|They're executing King Dendup tomorrow in Yolahn Square.|Dono|<ref name="The Soft War" />}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], an '''[[Death/Legends|execution]]''' was held at the capital city of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], at [[Yolahn Square/Legends|Yolahn Square]]. [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] ordered the execution of former king [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] and [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebel]] [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] to stimulate power to the Onderonians.

==History==
Dendup and Saw Gerrera were about to be executed by [[Electroguillotine/Legends|electroguillotine]] at Yolahn Square, just at the feet of [[Unifar Temple/Legends|Unifar Temple]]. However, in the last moment the Onderon rebels, led by [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], interrupted the execution by shooting the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. While the rebels were about to free the two, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] called for reinforcements, and in the process rebel [[Dono (Onderonian)/Legends|Dono]] was killed. The execution was about to be done at once, when General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]], leader of the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] and his men aided the rebels, so Dendup and Saw Gerrera could escape along with the other rebels. When Tandin was about to be killed by [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|force-pushed]] the droids, and helped Tandin to escape as well.<ref name="The Soft War" />
